Name: Name
FirstRunIntro: Create the administrator user. With it you can add products, categories and the rest of the team.
LoginTitle: Tap your name to sign in
UserLocked: User locked after too many attempts. Try again at {0} or ask an administrator to unlock it.
AdminPinTitle: This section needs an administrator PIN
CashClosedHint: You cannot sell with the register closed. Open it with the starting float.
CashOpenSince: Register open since {0} with a float of {1}.
SearchLimited: Showing the first {0}. Refine the search to see more.
ConfirmDeleteCategory: Press Delete again to confirm. Products in the category are not deleted: they are left without a category.
InactivityMinutes: Log out after these minutes idle (0 = never)
ErrorPinFormat: The PIN must have exactly 4 digits.
ErrorPinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
ErrorUserNameTaken: A user with that name already exists.
ErrorUserNotFound: The user does not exist or is deactivated.
ErrorLastAdmin: At least one active administrator must remain.
ErrorColorFormat: The colour must use the #RRGGBB format, for example #FF8800.
ErrorCategoryNameTaken: A category with that name already exists.
ErrorBarcodeTaken: Another product already has that barcode.
ErrorFloatNegative: The starting float cannot be negative.
SaleSearchHint: Scan or search a product (3*code = 3 units)
QuickCreateHint: Add it now so the sale doesn't stop.
QuickCreatePendingNote: It will be pending review by an administrator.
ErrorCardExceedsTotal: The card amount cannot exceed the total.
ErrorCashInsufficient: The cash tendered does not cover the total.
TicketSearchHint: Number, date or scan the ticket QR
InvoiceTicketHint: A full invoice will be issued replacing the ticket. A ticket can only be invoiced once.
BusinessFiscalHint: Tax details are mandatory: without them you cannot issue invoices or charge.
PrinterTargetWindows: Windows printer (install the driver or "Generic / Text Only")
PrinterTargetSerial: COM port (paired Bluetooth printers appear as COM)
ErrorBusinessNameRequired: The business name is missing (Settings > Business and ticket).
ErrorBusinessNif: The business VAT ID is not valid (Settings > Business and ticket).
ErrorBusinessAddressRequired: The business address is missing (Settings > Business and ticket).
ErrorCustomerNif: The customer VAT ID is not valid.
ErrorInvoiceNotSimplified: Only a ticket (simplified invoice) can be invoiced.
ErrorTicketAlreadyInvoiced: This ticket has already been invoiced.
ErrorPrintFailed: Could not print: {0}. The sale is saved; you can reprint it from Tickets.
CashClosedSummary: Register closed. Z report no. {0}. Difference: {1}
ErrorTicketNotEmpty: Charge or clear the ticket before closing the register.
LabelsHint: Scan or search products, choose how many labels of each and print. Products without a code get an internal one (starting with 29).
ErrorTooManyLabels: Too many copies of a product (maximum 500).
ImportHint: Download the template, fill it in Excel and choose the file. Do not change the column order.
ErrorNifTaken: A customer with that VAT ID already exists.
BackupHint: Full copy of all data, encrypted with a password. Keep it on a USB stick or in a OneDrive folder. It cannot be recovered without the password.
ConfirmRestore: ALL data will be replaced with the backup (a copy of the current state is saved first). Press Restore again to confirm.
ErrorBackupUnavailable: Backups are only available with the normal database.
ErrorBackupPasswordShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
ErrorBackupInvalid: The file is not a StarSeaPOS backup.
QrHint: Invoice verifiable on the AEAT website
VerifactuHint: Every invoice creates a record with a chained hash and QR code. In VERI*FACTU records are sent to the AEAT (offline they are queued and resent automatically); in No VERI*FACTU they are signed and kept.
VerifactuConnectionOk: Connection with the AEAT OK: the certificate is valid.
ErrorCertificatePassword: Wrong certificate password or invalid file.
ErrorCertificateNoKey: The certificate has no private key.
ErrorVerifactuNoCertificate: Load the digital certificate first (Settings > Verifactu).
ErrorVerifactuSend: Could not send to the AEAT; it will retry automatically.
ErrorVerifactuConnection: Could not connect to the AEAT: {0}
ProducerIncomplete: Software producer data is missing in producer.json: complete it before using Verifactu in production.
MaxCashierDiscount: Maximum cashier discount without admin PIN (%)
ErrorDiscountLimit: The discount exceeds the cashier limit: an administrator PIN is required.
ErrorDiscountTooBig: The discount cannot exceed the line amount.
ErrorNothingToReturn: Enter how many units are returned.
ErrorReturnTooMany: You cannot return more units than were sold.
GiftTicketHint: Show this receipt to exchange items.
GiftTicketPrinted: Gift receipt sent to the printer.
PrintLanguageHint: Tickets, invoices and the Z report are printed in this language. Tax data does not change.
PriceChangeHint: Raise or lower the prices of a category or the whole catalogue. A negative value lowers prices. Check the preview before applying.
ErrorPriceChangeZero: Enter how much the prices change.
ErrorNoProducts: There are no products in that category.
ErrorPriceWouldBeNegative: Some price would go below zero.
PriceCheckHint: Scan or search for a product. It is not added to the ticket.
VariantsHint: Size, colour or model. Each variant has its own barcode; without its own price it uses the product's.
ErrorVariantNameTaken: There is already a variant with that name.
ErrorEditVariantFromParent: Variants are edited from their product.
ErrorExportInvalid: The file is not a billing record export.
ErrorExportFileChanged: A file in the export has changed
ErrorExportHashMismatch: The hash does not match the record data
ErrorExportAmountsDiffer: The record amounts do not match the invoice
ErrorExportDiffersFromDatabase: The export does not match this application's record
ErrorFileWrite: The file could not be saved: {0}
BillingExported: Record exported to {0}: {1} records. Final hash: {2}
BillingVerified: Export is valid: {0} records, the hash chain is intact and matches this application's. Final hash: {1}
ExportHint: Products, customers, sales and invoices to Excel or CSV, with headers in the application language.
BillingRecordHint: All invoices and Verifactu records with their hash, in a ZIP for the tax office or the accountant. Any change to the file is detected when verifying it.
InvoiceBookReplacedNote: Tickets replaced by a full invoice (FAC-06) are struck through and do not add to the totals: the sale already counts in the full invoice.
ErrorDrawerFailed: The drawer could not be opened: {0}
CashDrawerHint: The drawer is connected to the receipt printer (RJ11 connector) and opens with a pulse. Opening it by hand without a sale asks for an administrator PIN and is recorded in the audit log.
OpenDrawerOnCash: Open the drawer on cash payments
CustomerDisplayHint: Second screen or pole display facing the customer: shows each product and the total, and a welcome message when idle. With a second monitor it uses that whole screen.
ErrorVerifactuNotEnabled: Corrections can only be sent in VERI*FACTU mode.
ErrorVerifactuNothingToCorrect: Only rejected records or records accepted with errors can be corrected.
ErrorVerifactuAlreadyCorrected: That record already has a pending or accepted correction.
ErrorVerifactuModeLocked: Records were already sent in VERI*FACTU this year: you cannot go back to No VERI*FACTU until 1 January.
VerifactuEventsBroken: The event log has been altered from event {0} onwards.
VerifactuAllSigned: All No VERI*FACTU records are signed.
VerifactuModeVeriFactu: VERI*FACTU: records are sent to the AEAT immediately
VerifactuModeNoVeriFactu: No VERI*FACTU: records are signed and kept; they are not sent
VerifactuModeHint: In No VERI*FACTU every record is signed with the certificate and an event log is kept. If you have already sent records in VERI*FACTU this year, you must stay in that mode until 1 January. The change is recorded.
ErrorExportEventsBroken: The export's event log has been altered
UpdateInstalling: Installing… the application will close and the new version will open.
ErrorUpdateChecksum: The download does not match the published one ({0}): it will not be installed.
ErrorUpdateBackup: Could not back up before updating: {0}
ErrorUpdateFeedUrl: The update address must start with https://
PrinterModelHint: If accents or the € print wrong, try another character table; if the QR does not print, choose "QR as image". The test print shows the settings.
PoleDisplayHint: Display connected through a serial or USB-COM port. Shows the last product and the total, and the welcome message when idle. Can be used together with the customer screen.
ScannerHint: A USB scanner in keyboard mode works with no setup (ending in Enter or Tab). Set a port only if the scanner is serial or in USB-COM mode.
